roadmap.title: Reclaim Algorithmic Control
roadmap.promise: Make the manipulation pattern visible, choose the matching intervention, and verify whether control improves.

sources.title: Social Media and Youth Mental Health: The U.S. Surgeon General's Advisory
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
sources.note: Evidence is strongest for youth; the roadmap must not generalize every risk estimate to all adults.

sources.title: Health advisory on social media use in adolescence
sources.note: Supports media literacy, monitoring, sleep protection, and developmentally appropriate boundaries.

sources.title: Digital Services Act, Regulation (EU) 2022/2065
sources.note: Provides authoritative definitions and obligations around recommender-system transparency and systemic risk.

sources.title: The Predictive Utility of Reward-Based Motives Underlying Excessive and Problematic Social Networking Sites Use
sources.publisher: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
sources.note: Examines social-reward motives; it does not establish that all frequent use is addiction.

sources.title: Problematic Social Networking Site use-effects on mental health and the brain
sources.note: Review emphasizing associations, uncertainty, and the need for more causal research.

sources.title: Potential risks of content, features, and functions
sources.note: Supports literacy and feature-level risk assessment for younger users.

sources.title: Recognize the Signs
sources.note: Acquisition visual and node summary; not treated as independent evidence.

resources.title: Recognize the Signs carousel
resources.relevance: Turns the opening signal into a fast self-observation prompt.
resources.expectedOutcome: User can name one observed feed pattern.

resources.title: Surgeon General advisory
resources.relevance: Provides benefits, risks, uncertainty, and protective actions.
resources.expectedOutcome: User separates evidence from broad anti-platform claims.

resources.title: Seven-day control log
resources.relevance: Records baseline, intervention, triggers, and outcome without requiring an app integration.
resources.expectedOutcome: A comparable baseline and follow-up record exists.

resources.title: Attention Boundary workbook
resources.relevance: Adds implementation templates and relapse planning after the branch is selected.
resources.expectedOutcome: The chosen boundary becomes repeatable across seven days.

resources.title: Professional support directory
resources.relevance: Routes users beyond self-guided scope when distress, safety, or loss of function is disclosed.
resources.expectedOutcome: User acknowledges and can access an appropriate human support route.

nodes.title: Recognize the Signs
nodes.purpose: Determine whether a recommendation loop is currently reducing deliberate choice.

surface.summary: Notice repetition, automatic checking, emotional hooks, and loss of deliberate stopping.

depth.overview: Start from observed behaviour, not a diagnosis or a claim about platform intent.
depth.mechanism: Recommendation systems optimize selected engagement objectives, while user outcomes vary by person, content, and context.
decide: Does at least one sign affect a valued activity?
act: Record one recent example and what it displaced.
constraints: Frequent use alone does not establish addiction or harm.

nodes.title: Capture the Decision State
nodes.purpose: Capture problem, outcome, constraint, readiness, and risk before selecting a branch.

surface.summary: Define what is happening, what must change, what limits action, readiness, and downside risk.

depth.overview: The same behaviour can require different actions when the desired outcome or risk differs.
depth.mechanism: Explicit constraints prevent the roadmap from recommending an intervention the user cannot sustain.
decide: Is the user here to understand, decide, or act?
act: Record one answer for each intent dimension.
constraints: High distress, danger, harassment, or material loss of function triggers escalation.

nodes.title: Understand the Loop
nodes.purpose: Separate recommender mechanics, social reward, and user vulnerability without collapsing them into one cause.

surface.summary: See how ranking, feedback, repetition, and context can reinforce automatic behaviour.

depth.overview: A recommender system selects and ranks content; the experienced effect depends on feedback, motives, content, and context.
depth.mechanism: Personalization can narrow exposure, social reward can reinforce checking, and emotionally salient content can interrupt deliberate control.
decide: Which mechanism best explains the recorded example?
act: Map trigger → platform response → user response → consequence.
constraints: Do not claim a single universal manipulation mechanism.

nodes.title: Name the Primary Pattern
nodes.purpose: Select the mechanism that changes the recommended intervention.

surface.summary: Choose attention capture, information narrowing, or emotional triggering.

depth.overview: This is a routing decision, not a permanent identity or clinical classification.
depth.mechanism: The chosen primary pattern determines which environmental intervention is tested first.
decide: Which pattern most directly blocks the desired outcome?
act: Select one branch and record confidence from 0 to 1.
constraints: Select the dominant current pattern; secondary patterns remain in state.

forbidden: select a branch without user confirmation

nodes.title: Install an Attention Boundary
nodes.purpose: Reduce automatic entry and switching through environmental friction.

surface.summary: Remove one trigger and define one deliberate access window.

depth.overview: Change access conditions before relying on repeated self-control.
depth.mechanism: Removing cues and adding a deliberate access rule interrupts automatic checking.
decide: Which trigger can be removed without blocking necessary communication?
act: Disable one nonessential notification.
Move the app away from the primary workspace.
Set one access window.

nodes.title: Diversify the Signal
nodes.purpose: Test whether deliberate source diversity reduces information narrowing.

surface.summary: Create a small source set outside the current recommendation loop.

depth.overview: Add credible alternatives rather than treating random opposition as balance.
depth.mechanism: Deliberate source selection creates comparison points outside personalized ranking.
decide: Which claim or topic needs viewpoint and evidence diversity?
act: Add one primary source.
Add one credible competing interpretation.
Compare provenance before reaction.
constraints: Diversity is not equivalence; weight evidence quality.

forbidden: equate low-credibility sources with authoritative evidence

nodes.title: Create an Emotional Delay
nodes.purpose: Insert time between emotional activation and engagement or sharing.

surface.summary: Name the trigger, delay the response, and verify before acting.

depth.overview: The aim is response choice, not suppression of emotion.
depth.mechanism: A defined pause creates room to inspect source, claim, and intended action.
decide: Which action requires a delay: comment, share, purchase, or continued viewing?
act: Name the emotion.
Wait for the chosen interval.
Check the original source before acting.
constraints: Do not use delay to ignore threats, harassment, or urgent safety needs.

nodes.title: Measure the First Change
nodes.purpose: Compare the chosen intervention with the recorded baseline.

surface.summary: Measure deliberate stopping, displacement, and felt control after the first test.

depth.overview: This convergence compares branch-specific actions using one shared outcome frame.
depth.mechanism: A baseline and follow-up prevent completion from meaning only that content was read.
act: Record the same measures used at baseline.
Log adherence and exceptions.
constraints: A short self-test is not clinical evidence.

nodes.title: Stabilize the Working Boundary
nodes.purpose: Turn the successful intervention into a repeatable seven-day rule.

surface.summary: Keep what worked, define exceptions, and set a review trigger.

depth.overview: Preserve the smallest intervention that produced a meaningful improvement.
depth.mechanism: An explicit rule reduces repeated decision cost while leaving room for revision.
decide: What must stay fixed for seven days?
act: Write the rule, exceptions, and review date.
constraints: Do not expand the restriction beyond the measured problem without evidence.

nodes.title: Reassess the Constraint
nodes.purpose: Identify whether branch choice, adherence, measurement, or an external constraint explains the weak result.

surface.summary: Separate intervention failure from implementation or measurement failure.

depth.overview: Do not intensify the same action until the weak point is identified.
depth.mechanism: A failed test may reflect misclassification, poor adherence, insufficient duration, or an unaddressed constraint.
decide: Was the branch wrong, action incomplete, measure weak, or constraint dominant?
act: Record one primary failure mode and one bounded revision.
constraints: Repeated self-guided failure with material distress should route to escalation.

nodes.title: Move Beyond Self-Guided Scope
nodes.purpose: Route material distress, safety concerns, harassment, or persistent loss of function to appropriate human support.

surface.summary: Pause self-guided optimization and choose an appropriate human support route.

depth.overview: Escalation is a valid roadmap outcome, not a failed node.
depth.mechanism: Some risks require context, duty of care, or professional judgment the roadmap cannot provide.
decide: Which support route matches the disclosed risk?
act: Open the relevant support resource.
Record whether immediate help is required.
constraints: The contextual chat must not substitute for emergency or professional support.

nodes.title: Commit the Seven-Day Test
nodes.purpose: Converge successful and revised paths into one measurable next test.

surface.summary: Freeze the intervention, measure, exceptions, and return date.

depth.overview: Both stable and revised paths need the same explicit testing contract.
depth.mechanism: A time-bounded commitment converts intention into a comparable execution period.
decide: Is the test specific, safe, measurable, and feasible for seven days?
act: Record rule, measure, exception, and return date.
constraints: Do not mark verified until the follow-up measure exists.

nodes.title: Run the Control Protocol
nodes.purpose: Execute the committed rule and preserve exceptions and outcome evidence.

surface.summary: Run the seven-day test and return with the recorded outcome.

depth.overview: Execution remains simple: apply one rule, record one measure, preserve exceptions.
depth.mechanism: Consistent measurement makes later revision attributable and inspectable.
decide: Did the test meet its completion and safety conditions?
act: Run the rule for seven days.
Record deviations and final measure.
constraints: Stop and escalate if risk increases.

nodes.title: Add Execution Support
nodes.purpose: Attach a template, accountability mechanism, or paid depth pack without changing branch logic.

surface.summary: Choose support because execution needs it, not because a paid resource controls routing.

depth.overview: Resources remain optional and disclose commercial status.
depth.mechanism: A resource can reduce execution friction but cannot alter risk classification or eligibility.
decide: Is free support sufficient, or does paid depth solve a named execution gap?
act: Select a resource or continue without one.
constraints: Paid access must never be a prerequisite for completing the core roadmap.

forbidden: prefer paid resource in branch selection

nodes.title: Resolve the Current Path
nodes.purpose: Return a result, verification state, unresolved risks, and next review date.

surface.summary: See what changed, what remains unresolved, and when the node should reopen.

depth.overview: The terminal records resolution without claiming the broader problem is permanently solved.
depth.mechanism: A result joins upstream decisions, action evidence, risk, and resource state into one inspectable output.
decide: What condition should reopen the roadmap?
act: Set the next review date.
Export or share the exact current path.
constraints: Verified requires matching measured outcome or acknowledged escalation evidence.

metrics.when: A node becomes the active selected node.
Overview, Evidence, Decide, Act, Resources, or Ask is opened.
A required diagnostic field is explicitly recorded.
The user confirms a branch and its state record is written.
An ACTION node receives its first execution log.
The node's declared verification evidence exists.
A node-attached resource is opened with access and affiliate classification logged.
Contextual chat responds within the current node boundary.
New evidence or a reopen condition changes a completed or verified node to active.
The terminal result contains result state, unresolved risk, and next review date.
